post.description: Experiences near a place that are on during the dates given: festivals, concerts, matches, markets, shows and exhibitions. The place is a location's slug, such as hermanus, or a point. Dates match an experience's sessions, so an experience is returned only when it is on inside the range, and each result carries the sessions that fall inside it. An experience is bookable when it is confirmed, its booking is open and it has a link to book through: its booking link, or failing that its own page. An attribute, option, tag or season that does not exist is refused with invalid_input. The filters decide what is returned; the query text only orders the results.

location.description: The place to search around, as a location's slug, such as hermanus. The search is around the location's centre. Give this or near, not both.

near.description: The point to search around, such as the centre of Hermanus (-34.4187, 19.2345), when the place is not a location. Give this or location, not both.

radiusKm.description: How far from the location's centre or the point to search, in kilometres. The default is used when it is left out.

from.description: The first day of the stay, as YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: The last day of the stay, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be before the first day.

status.description: Only experiences with one of these statuses. All four are returned when it is left out.

bookable.description: True returns only experiences that can be booked now: confirmed, with booking open, and with a booking link or, failing that, their own page to book through.

attributes.description: Filters by attribute key, such as category, format, audience, setting, scale or minimum_age. Every attribute given must match. A list matches any of its values, and { min, max } is a number range. A range with only a max, such as minimum_age: { max: 12 }, also matches experiences with no value recorded. A key that is not an attribute, or a value that is not one of its options, is refused, and the error lists what can be used.

tags.description: Tag slugs and season slugs, such as jazz, whales or whale-season. An experience with any one of them matches. A slug that is no tag or season is refused, and the error names the closest ones.

query.description: What the traveller likes, in plain words. It only orders the results, best match first, and never adds or removes one. Put anything that must hold in the filters.

offset.description: How many experiences to skip, for paging.

distanceKm.description: The distance from the search point, in kilometres.

price.description: The lowest and highest price. A min and max of 0 mean it is free; empty means the source states no price.

pageUrl.description: The experience's own page, when it has one.

attributes.description: The experience's values by attribute key, such as its categories.

precision.description: Month or year means the experience is on in that month or year and its days are not announced yet.

sessions.description: The sessions that fall inside the dates asked for. The experience is on no other day in that range.

bookable.description: True when it can be booked now: confirmed, booking open, and a link to book through, its bookingUrl or, failing that, its pageUrl. Everything else is information only.

total.description: How many experiences match, across all pages.

post.description: What changed since a client's last search, among the experiences the same search parameters select: new, confirmed, rescheduled, postponed, cancelled, removed or otherwise changed. Give the parameters of the search, without its query text, and the time of the last search. Cancelled and removed experiences are reported, though search no longer returns them; experiences that are over are not. An experience that was on during the dates before a change since then, and is not now, is reported with movedOut true and the sessions it has now, outside the dates. Each result has the change that matters most to a planner and every change since, newest first. The most recent change comes first.

location.description: The place to search around, as a location's slug, such as hermanus. The search is around the location's centre. Give this or near, not both.

near.description: The point to search around, such as the centre of Hermanus (-34.4187, 19.2345), when the place is not a location. Give this or location, not both.

radiusKm.description: How far from the location's centre or the point to search, in kilometres. The default is used when it is left out.

from.description: The first day of the stay, as YYYY-MM-DD.

to.description: The last day of the stay, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be before the first day.

attributes.description: Filters by attribute key, such as category, format, audience, setting, scale or minimum_age. Every attribute given must match. A list matches any of its values, and { min, max } is a number range. A range with only a max, such as minimum_age: { max: 12 }, also matches experiences with no value recorded. A key that is not an attribute, or a value that is not one of its options, is refused, and the error lists what can be used.

tags.description: Tag slugs and season slugs, such as jazz, whales or whale-season. An experience with any one of them matches. A slug that is no tag or season is refused, and the error names the closest ones.

status.description: Only experiences with one of these statuses. Cancelled and removed experiences are reported whatever it says.

bookable.description: True reports only experiences that can be booked now, confirmed with booking open, and the cancelled and removed ones.

since.description: When you last searched, as an ISO timestamp such as 2027-02-01T09:30:00Z. Only later changes are reported.

limit.description: How many changed experiences to return.

offset.description: How many changed experiences to skip, for paging.

status.description: Cancelled and removed experiences are final.

distanceKm.description: The distance from the search point, in kilometres.

price.description: The lowest and highest price. A min and max of 0 mean it is free; empty means the source states no price.

pageUrl.description: The experience's own page, when it has one.

attributes.description: The experience's values by attribute key, such as its categories.

precision.description: Month or year means the experience is on in that month or year and its days are not announced yet.

sessions.description: The sessions inside the dates asked for. When movedOut is true it has none there, and these are the sessions it has now, all outside the dates: where it moved to. Empty when it has no dates left.

bookable.description: True when it can be booked now: confirmed, booking open, and a link to book through, its bookingUrl or, failing that, its pageUrl. Everything else is information only.

movedOut.description: True when the experience was on during the dates asked for before a change since then, and is not on during them now: it moved out of the dates, or its sessions in them were dropped or cancelled. Treat it as no longer on during the stay.

kind.description: new: first published. confirmed: its dates are now fixed. rescheduled: a date was added, moved or removed. postponed: not happening on its dates, new dates unknown. cancelled: called off by its organisers. removed: no source lists it any more. changed: anything else, booking and price included.

change.description: The change that matters most to a planner.

kind.description: new: first published. confirmed: its dates are now fixed. rescheduled: a date was added, moved or removed. postponed: not happening on its dates, new dates unknown. cancelled: called off by its organisers. removed: no source lists it any more. changed: anything else, booking and price included.

changes.description: Every change since the time given, newest first.

items.description: The experiences that changed, the most recent change first.

total.description: How many experiences changed, across all pages.
